## 更新内容 / Changes

- 修复会话管理“修复可见性”在选择目录后提示 `An object could not be cloned`：Vue 响应式选择会在 IPC 前转换为普通数组，并加入 Electron IPC 回归测试。
- 复制实例默认只迁移会话历史；同一实例目录内内容完全相同的同 ID rollout 会稳定去重，内容不同的副本仍明确标记冲突并阻止不安全操作。跨实例同 ID 会话继续作为不同来源展示。
- 建立 Claude Code CLI 的第一阶段基础契约、只读检测、隔离配置预览和参数保护。Claude Code 仍处于 planned 状态，不会出现在创建向导；Anthropic Messages 协议、全局状态归属、账号与恢复事务将在独立验收后开放。

- Fixed the session visibility repair dialog's `An object could not be cloned` error by converting Vue reactive selections to plain arrays before Electron IPC, with renderer regression coverage.
- Session-only instance copies now treat byte-identical same-directory rollout files with the same ID as one logical session, while different bodies remain an explicit conflict. Same IDs from separate instance directories remain separate sources.
- Added the first Claude Code CLI foundation: a planned client contract, read-only executable discovery, isolated configuration projection, and argument guards. Claude Code is not selectable yet; Anthropic Messages, global-state ownership, account compatibility, and recovery must pass a separate validation phase first.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。升级前退出应用；账号、实例与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Quit the app before upgrading; accounts, instances and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

当前支持 Codex，Claude Code 与 Claude Desktop（Chat / Cowork / Code）仍是计划功能。客户端需单独安装；模型、登录和会话隔离能力以实际适配器验证为准。

Codex is currently supported. Claude Code and Claude Desktop (Chat / Cowork / Code) remain planned features. Clients must be installed separately; model, login, and session isolation support will depend on verified adapters.
